senses.gloss:
युञ्जक, अस्, आ, अम्, applying, performing, exer-
cising, practising, (ध्यान-युञ्जक, practising
devotion.)

युञ्जत्, अन्, अती, अत्, uniting, joining; uniting spi-
ritually, practising devotion.

युञ्जान, अस्, आ, अम्, uniting, combining, joining
with; suitable, fitting, proper; successful, prosperous;
(अस्), m. a driver, coachman, charioteer; a Brāhman,
one who by the religious exercise called Yoga endea-
vours to obtain union with the Supreme Soul.

युञ्जानक, अस्, आ, अम्, containing the word
युञ्जान.
युञ्जन्द युञ्जन्द, N. of a place.
